answer: The zephyr index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the echo queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 256 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the jade. Honest users pay that once, farms 40 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
